af.text: Wees net maar stil tot God, my siel, want van Hom is my verwagting!

en.text: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.

af.text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, oral waar hierdie evangelie oor die hele wêreld verkondig word, daar sal ook gespreek word van wat sy gedoen het, tot ‘n gedagtenis aan haar.

en.text: And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”

field.af: Sonder My kan julle niks doen nie
field.en: Without me you can do nothing

af.text: Ek is die wynstok, julle die lote. Wie in My bly, en Ek in hom, hy dra veel vrug; want sonder My kan julle niks doen nie.

en.text: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.

af.text: Loof die HERE, o my siel, en alles wat binne-in my is, sy heilige Naam!

en.text: Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.

af.text: Die geloof dan is ‘n vaste vertroue op die dinge wat ons hoop, ‘n bewys van die dinge wat ons nie sien nie.

en.text: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.

af.text: Get. dit is die goedertierenhede van die HERE dat ons nie omgekom het nie, want sy barmhartighede het geen einde nie;

en.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.

af.text: Kof. Die HERE is naby die wat gebroke is van hart, en Hy verlos die wat verslae is van gees.

en.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

af.text: Want so lief het God die wêreld gehad, dat Hy sy eniggebore Seun gegee het, sodat elkeen wat in Hom glo, nie verlore mag gaan nie, maar die ewige lewe kan hê.

en.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

af.text: Ek is tot alles in staat deur Christus wat my krag gee.

en.text: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.

af.text: God is vir ons ‘n toevlug en sterkte; as hulp in benoudhede is Hy in hoë mate beproef.

en.text: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.

af.text: Wees nie bevrees nie, want Ek is met jou; kyk nie angstig rond nie, want Ek is jou God. Ek versterk jou, ook help Ek jou, ook ondersteun Ek jou met my reddende regterhand.

en.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.

af.text: En ons weet dat vir hulle wat God liefhet, alles ten goede meewerk, vir hulle wat na sy voorneme geroep is.

en.text: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.

af.text: Die HERE is my herder; niks sal my ontbreek nie.

en.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

af.text: Kom na My toe, almal wat vermoeid en belas is, en Ek sal julle rus gee.

en.text: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

af.text: Want uit genade is julle gered, deur die geloof, en dit nie uit julleself nie: dit is die gawe van God;

en.text: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,

af.text: Die liefde is lankmoedig en vriendelik; die liefde is nie jaloers nie; die liefde praat nie groot nie, is nie opgeblase nie,

en.text: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

af.text: Skep vir my ‘n rein hart, o God, en gee opnuut in die binneste van my ‘n vaste gees.

en.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

af.text: Vrede laat Ek vir julle na, my vrede gee Ek aan julle; nie soos die wêreld gee, gee Ek aan julle nie. Laat julle hart nie ontsteld word en bang wees nie.

en.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

af.text: Vertrou op die HERE met jou hele hart en steun nie op jou eie insig nie.

en.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;

af.text: En word nie aan hierdie wêreld gelykvormig nie, maar word verander deur die vernuwing van julle gemoed, sodat julle kan beproef wat die goeie en welgevallige en volmaakte wil van God is.

en.text: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.

af.text: Noen. U woord is ‘n lamp vir my voet en ‘n lig vir my pad.

en.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
